decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly swarm the battlefield with Elf creatures, utilizing cards like Gaea's Cradle and Priest of Titania to generate massive amounts of mana. Survival of the Fittest allows for efficient creature tutoring, while cards like Tangle Wire can disrupt opponent's game plans. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Deranged Hermit and Elvish Champion provides additional threats on the board. With a strong mana base and synergistic Elf creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to establish board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of removal spells and hand disruption. Using cards like Duress, Cabal Therapy, and Innocent Blood to strip away the opponent's resources, while utilizing Contamination and Contagion to maintain control of the board. Zombie Infestation and Nether Spirit provide a constant stream of threats, while cards like Engineered Plague and Powder Keg allow for targeted removal. The emphasis is on slowing down the opponent's game plan and overpowering them with efficient threats and removal.

The deck focuses on using various control elements such as counterspells, removal, and board wipes to control the game while also locking down the opponent's resources with land destruction. The deck aims to stall the game out until it can establish a dominant board presence or find key combo pieces to win the game. It also utilizes card draw and selection to dig for important cards and maintain card advantage. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents to secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful creature for a low cost. Meddling Mage and Counterspell are used to protect the combo while disruption cards like Tsabo's Web and Wasteland help control the opponent's board. Card draw and filtering are provided by Accumulated Knowledge, Gush, and Portent, while permission spells like Foil and Daze help to protect the game plan. The deck aims to efficiently control the game while setting up and executing the combo for a decisive win.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient Goblin creatures to swarm the opponent, overwhelming them with aggression and high damage output. By maximizing the number of powerful Goblins like Goblin Piledriver and Goblin Warchief, while also including key support cards like Goblin Lackey and Siege-Gang Commander, the deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence and pressure the opponent into submission. Additionally, the inclusion of disruption cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Pyrokinesis helps to control the battlefield and clear the way for lethal attacks.

The deck focuses on using various creatures and spells to control the game and survive until victory. It utilizes cards like Natural Order to bring out powerful creatures, Winter Orb to lock down opponents, and Survival of the Fittest to search for key creatures. The deck also includes mana producers like Fyndhorn Elves and Birds of Paradise to ramp up quickly. With a mix of counter spells, removal, and card advantage, the deck aims to outlast opponents and secure the win through efficient and strategic play.

This deck focuses on maintaining control over the game by utilizing a combination of spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up your own board presence. By using cards like Meddling Mage and Mother of Runes to hinder your opponent's plays, along with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing, you can protect your own creatures and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The deck also includes some card advantage and tutoring options to help find the right answers at the right time.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and board state while applying pressure with discard spells and efficient removal. The deck aims to control the game through a combination of hand disruption with cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress, along with targeted removal like Smother and Snuff Out. The inclusion of The Rack and Bottomless Pit adds additional pressure to the opponent, forcing them to discard cards and take damage. With a solid land base and a mix of creatures, removal, and disruption, this deck aims to grind out a win through attrition.

The main concept of this Mono Blue Control deck is to use counterspells, removal, and card draw to control the game and outvalue the opponent. With a mix of counterspells like Counterspell and Force Spike, along with removal like Nevinyrral's Disk and Powder Keg, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage through cards like Accumulated Knowledge and Whispers of the Muse. The deck also utilizes utility lands like Mishra's Factory and Quicksand to provide additional control options in the match.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board through disruptive cards like Sphere of Resistance, Stone Rain, and Winter's Grasp while using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore. The deck looks to lock down opponents with land destruction and disruption spells while building up its own board presence with efficient threats. The inclusion of utility lands like Rishadan Port and Mishra's Factory further adds to the control aspect of the deck, making it difficult for opponents to develop their own game plan.

The primary strategy of this deck is to use Frantic Search to draw cards and fill up the graveyard with enchantments such as Parallax Wave and Parallax Tide. This sets up for a big Replenish play, bringing back multiple enchantments from the graveyard to overwhelm the opponent with threats. Cards like Swords to Plowshares and Stifle help control the opponent's board while Intuition helps tutor for key pieces. The deck also includes mana acceleration via Ancient Tomb and City of Traitors to cast spells faster.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Phyrexian Dreadnought combo by playing the Dreadnought and countering any removal spells with Stifle or Foil. The deck aims to control the game with counterspells and draw spells like Accumulated Knowledge and Opt, while using Mishra's Factory as a backup win condition. The combination of cards like Gush and Daze allows the deck to efficiently protect its key combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of removal spells and hand disruption. The deck utilizes efficient creatures like Blastoderm and Ravenous Baloth to apply pressure while also generating card advantage with Wall of Blossoms. The inclusion of cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress allows for disruption of the opponent's hand, while Pernicious Deed serves as a versatile board wipe. Recurring Nightmare provides a way to bring back key creatures from the graveyard for continued value.
